meta.title: Agafay Desert Sunset Day Trip | Shared Morocco Adventures
meta.description: A half/full-day shared trip from Marrakech to the Agafay stone desert — camel ride and golden-hour sunset, no overnight required. From €46pp.
meta.ogDescription: A shared day trip from Marrakech to the Agafay stone desert for a camel ride and sunset. From €46pp.

hero.lead: Marrakech → Agafay Stone Desert → Camel Ride → Sunset Point → Marrakech

paras: Desert views without the desert-length drive — the Agafay stone desert sits just 30–40 minutes from Marrakech, close enough for a camel ride and full golden-hour sunset in one afternoon, no overnight required.
A rocky, dune-like plateau with High Atlas backdrops, very different scenery from the Sahara dunes near Merzouga, and one of the best-value sunset experiences near the city.
chips: 🚗 ≈75 km round trip · about 1.5 hrs driving

price.sub: per person · departs daily, timed to sunset

paras: Want to make it a full evening? Ask about the optional desert-camp dinner add-on with live music, available for a small extra cost.
Booking terms: Send an enquiry first; we confirm the departure time, final price, and pickup details by email. No payment is taken through this website.

items.q: Is this the same as the Sahara desert?
items.a: No — Agafay is a rocky stone desert close to Marrakech, quite different in look from the sand dunes of the Sahara near Merzouga, which is a multi-day trip.

items.q: What time does the trip depart?
items.a: Departure time shifts through the year to catch sunset — typically mid-to-late afternoon. We'll confirm the exact pickup time when you book.

items.q: Is there a version with an overnight desert camp?
items.a: Yes — see our 3-Day Atlas Mountains & Agafay Group Escape for a version with a full overnight camp stay.
